question: Who was the Nawab of Bengal during the Battle of Plassey?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Siraj ud- Daulah**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **During the Battle of Plassey**(**23rd June 1757**), **Siraj-ud-Daulah **was the **Nawab of Bengal**.
 
• In this battle **Siraj-ud-Daula **was **betrayed by **his **own forces **and **British forces defeated him**.
 
• After **this battle he was forced to step down **and **British forces declared Mir Jafar **the **next Nawab of Bengal**.
 
• **Battle of Plassey **was **fought on the banks of river Bhagirathi **near **Murshidabad**(the then **capital of Bengal).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amichand Rajbansi **was a **South African politician**. He was **a former Chairman of the Ministers' Council **of the **House of Delegates Tricameral parliamentary **chamber for **Indian people**, and **leader of the Minority Front**. **Amichand Rajbansi**, **nicknamed **the **Bengal Tiger, **was born in **Clairwood**, **Durban **on **14 January 1942**.
 
• **Mir Qasim **was the **Nawab of Bengal **from **1760 to 1763**. He was **installed as Nawab **with the **support of the British East India Company**, **replacing Mir Jafar.**
 
• **Sayyid Mir Jafar Ali Khan Bahadur **was a **military general **who became the **first dependent Nawab **of **Bengal **of the **British East India Company.**
